items.Sentence: The treatment system consists of a headworks, two oxidation ponds, a treatment wetland, and ozone disinfection system.

The Facility’s two oxidation ponds are operated in series and are used to reduce biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) and total suspended solids (TSS).
Following the oxidation ponds, effluent is gravity fed to the treatment wetland
from the treatment wetland is screened prior to entering the ozone treatment system.
The ozone disinfection system consists of two ozone generators, an injection system, an ozone destruction unit, and a multi-cell contact chamber.

When chlorination is necessary for surface water discharges at Discharge Point 001, calcium hypochlorite tablets are added at Discharge Manhole No. 1 and sodium sulfite tablets are added at Discharge Manhole No. 2 for de-chlorination.
When chlorination is necessary for land discharges at Discharge Point 002, sodium hypochlorite tablets are added in the discharge pipe.
A septage receiving station ... includes a rock trap, grinder, and mixing tank. However, the septage receiving station is not currently used
The Permittee is also pursuing grant funding to upgrade the collection system, influent wet well, and headworks.
